title: Vote: release Apache Iceberg 1.12.0 RC1
summary: The vote thread for Apache Iceberg 1.12.0 RC1 surfaced several issues. nssalian summarized them: a fix for issue #18164 (reading variant columns failed with commons-lang3 older than 3.13) in PR #18208 should go into the next RC; the fix in PR #18069 was already in this RC; and a missing Caffeine LICENSE entry found by Kurtis needs a new RC. He closed the thread and said a new candidate would be built with Amogh. kevinjqliu then reviewed bundled dependencies: Caffeine was fixed by PR #18218, OpenTelemetry and Apache HttpComponents 5 were already covered, CEL Java is a non-blocking nit (PR #18226), and a new gap for Jackson was found (PR #18227). He suggested adding a license check to the release process. Jean-Baptiste Onofré voted -1 (non-binding) over the incomplete bundle LICENSE files. nssalian reported the license fixes merged.

positions.stance: A new release candidate is needed to include the commons-lang3 variant fix and the missing Caffeine license entry.
The Jackson attribution gap in PR #18227 is what blocks the next RC, and the release process should include a license check.
Votes -1 because the GCP bundle LICENSE omits Caffeine and the Jackson (FastDoubleParser) entry needs updating in several bundle and runtime LICENSE files.

outcome.note: The release manager closed the thread and said a new release candidate would be cut to include the fixes; the license fixes were later reported merged.

why_it_matters: Incomplete LICENSE entries in bundled runtime jars were enough to restart the 1.12.0 release candidate, and a license check in the release process was suggested.
